verdict.rationale: A government e-filing service could plausibly ship an official command-line tool, so this axis applies. The evidence only describes the web portal (dashboards, online filing, FranceConnect+ login) and the Start INPI guidance app; nothing documents an official CLI. The keyless recherche-entreprises API probe concerns a separate state data API rather than a Guichet unique CLI, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
